line_items.reasoning: No specific capex figures were reported for Q2 that contradict the full-year $225M–$245M guidance; strong operating cash flow of $258M and continued hub automation/FMI/IT investments suggest spending remains on track.

Guidance called for ~30 bps of incremental Q2 operating margin headwind from expo/customer service investments, but actual operating margin declined 80 bps YoY and gross margin fell 40 bps — meaningfully worse than the guided incremental pressure, driven by mix, pricing slippage, and demand weakness beyond what was anticipated.

Full-year gross margin was guided to be down 'modestly' and consistent with Q1's 20 bps decline, but Q2 gross margin fell 40 bps YoY to 45.1% — double the Q1 rate of decline — due to product/customer mix deterioration and negative pricing in non-fastener/safety categories, indicating the cadence is tracking worse than guided.
